steps.name: Collection
steps.text: We collect your used X-ray film on a scheduled date, in sealed containers. The film is weighed on site, and you receive a signed receipt and payment at the agreed rate.

steps.name: Sorting & secure destruction
steps.text: At our facility, the film is sorted and prepared in a controlled environment. Patient information is destroyed in the process, and you receive a certificate of destruction.

steps.name: Silver extraction & refining
steps.text: Silver is recovered from the film through a safe, controlled process, then refined and tested for purity.

steps.name: Silver back to market
steps.text: The recovered silver is sold to silver shops and refiners at the market price, with an assay report for every batch. The remaining materials are handled responsibly.

hero.title: Turning silver into green.
hero.sub: Argentum is a Lebanese company that recovers silver from used X-ray film. Green stands for both the environmental impact and the value we create.

mission.label: Mission
mission.text: To make silver recovery from medical waste the standard in Lebanon: safe for patient data, fair to our suppliers, and good for the environment.

vision.label: Vision
vision.text: A world where no X-ray film ends up in landfill, and every gram of silver returns to use.

name.title: Why Argentum?
name.text: Argentum is the Latin word for silver. It is also where silver’s chemical symbol, Ag, comes from.

impact.title: Environmental impact
impact.text: Used X-ray film contains silver, a heavy metal that can pollute soil and water when film is dumped or burned. By collecting the film and recovering its silver, Argentum keeps it out of landfill, reduces the need for newly mined silver, and returns a valuable metal to the local economy. Every collection is weighed and documented, so our partners can report their own environmental contribution.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.text: Argentum recovers silver from used X-ray film in Lebanon. This policy explains how we handle the information you send us through this website.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.text: Only what you enter in our forms: organisation, contact person, job title, e-mail, phone, region, quantities and notes. We do not collect patient information through this website.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.text: To answer your request, arrange collections, send offers and keep a record of our business relationship. We never sell or rent your details.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.text: If you accept analytics cookies, we use Google Analytics to measure visits in aggregate. If you decline, no analytics cookies are set.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.text: For as long as needed to serve you and to meet our legal and accounting obligations.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.text: You can ask us to see, correct or delete your details at any time, using the contact details on this website.
